description: Figure 4 is a grouped bar chart that compares the popularity of ground-truth entities (Pop_GT) and generated entities (Pop_Ge) in incorrectly answered samples, as well as the popularity of ground-truth entities in correctly answered samples. The horizontal axis displays three categories: "Movies," "Songs," and "Basketball." The vertical axis represents the ratio in percentage, ranging from 50 to 90. The chart includes three models: Llama3 (blue), Qwen2 (red), and ChatGPT (yellow). For each category, there are three bars: the first bar represents Pop_GT in incorrectly answered samples, the second represents Pop_Ge in incorrectly answered samples, and the third represents Pop_GT in correctly answered samples. The legend is located at the top of the chart. In the "Movies" category, the ratio for Pop_GT in incorrect answers (blue bar) is approximately 90%, Pop_Ge in incorrect answers (red bar) is slightly lower at about 89%, and Pop_GT in correct answers (yellow bar) is around 72%. In the "Songs" category, the ratios are approximately 85% for Pop_GT (incorrect), 90% for Pop_Ge (incorrect), and 62% for Pop_GT (correct). In the "Basketball" category, the ratios are about 66% for Pop_GT (incorrect), 57% for Pop_Ge (incorrect), and 61% for Pop_GT (correct). The chart visually illustrates that in incorrectly answered samples, the popularity of generated entities (Pop_Ge) is often higher than that of ground-truth entities (Pop_GT), particularly for "Songs," while in correctly answered samples, the popularity of ground-truth entities is generally lower.
